title: Scottish Land Commission — Land Reform & Community Empowerment AI Deep-Dive Governance Pack
description: 12-entry-point AI governance framework for the Scottish Land Commission (SLC) — the statutory body for land reform and land rights in Scotland — covering land rights and responsibilities, community empowerment, land value capture, vacant and derelict land, common good assets, housing land, ownership transparency, tenant farming, and natural capital governance. Red lines: no AI-sole land ownership determinations; no automated land valuation.
